alignment_reasoning: The image demonstrates high fidelity to the Dungeness crab class. Key diagnostic features like stalked eyes, serrated claw edges, dark-tipped chelipeds, and carapace mottling are all present and correct. The `fine_grained_classifier` strongly confirms the species (Top-1 logit 7.07 vs Top-2 5.89), ruling out look-alikes like King Crab or Rock Crab. The asymmetry of the claws adds to the biological plausibility. Only one checkpoint (ventral surface) was untestable; all others passed.
artifact_reasoning: While the main subject is structurally sound, there are subtle generative artifacts in the background and peripheral limbs. However, the primary subject (carapace and claws) has sharp boundaries and realistic specular highlights, preventing a lower score.
